completed_tasks.name: Discuss area: Visual style & colors (5 decisions)

remaining_tasks.name: Final check: explore more gray areas or ready for context

decisions.decision: NO Tableau reference — standalone project; do not consider the Tableau prototype as an example for the rest of the project (overrides DASH-11 'matching Tableau styling' wording; the four chart types remain)

Layout: one large hero chart + three live mini previews in a row below; clicking a mini rotates it into the hero slot; BP Timeline is default hero; quick ~200-300ms animated swap (reduced-motion fallback)
decisions.rationale: Maps to voice chart-switching, keeps all charts glanceable

decisions.decision: Nautical/naval visual theme: ocean pastels as canvas only (backgrounds/surfaces), navy + deep tones for all text/data/interactive elements; BP categories keep clinical green→red semantics tuned to the palette; light AND dark themes with a large toggle; subtle nautical motifs (header mark, wave dividers, themed empty states)
decisions.rationale: User's freeform direction reconciled with the non-negotiable high-contrast constraint

decisions.decision: Charts: fixed clinical y-axes (BP ~40-220, pulse ~30-120), dots at every reading, direct large-text line labels, subtle AHA tinted zones, click/tap + keyboard point inspection (no hover), count+percent labels on category bars, empty state with guidance + 'Show all data' button
Filters: segmented button row for date presets, large ≥48px calendar pickers + typed entry for custom range, single-select button groups for AM/PM and category, all in a horizontal bar above the hero
decisions.rationale: 48px targets, glanceable state, 1:1 mapping to Phase 3 voice command schema
